item.title: Musk CFA lending a hand and raising funds
item.description: Putting their local area to good use, the Musk CFA brigade recently transported 50 rolls of hay to the Harcourt Relief Station. CFA secretary John Franklin said the majority of the grass was donated by Rijk Zwaan of Musk from one of their surrounding paddocks with farmer Trevor Brown cutting and rolling it with help from Jed Neville and the rest of the brigade.
